Mira and Dain reach the flooded village seeking shelter. The innkeeper offers them beds if they help find the missing ferryman.

The players discuss whether the next session should start at seven or eight. The GM explains how initiative will work later.

At the empty ferry house, Mira finds a torn royal seal. Dain recognizes the mark of the tax collector, turning a rescue into a political investigation.

The collector denies involvement. When Mira shows him the seal, he admits that he hired smugglers to move the ferryman across the marsh.

Dain wants to arrest the collector immediately. Mira decides to leave him under guard and follow the smugglers before the rising river erases their trail.

At the marsh bridge, a smuggler fires an arrow. Dain takes cover behind a pillar.

Mira crosses the broken planks while Dain distracts the archer. Another smuggler blocks her path.

They fight through the ambush and capture the archer. Dain is wounded, but neither smuggler escapes across the bridge.

The captured archer reveals that the ferryman volunteered to hide a royal witness. The collector's payments financed the escape rather than an abduction.

At an abandoned mill, the ferryman asks them to protect the witness. Mira promises safe passage despite Dain's doubts about defying the crown.

They lead the witness through a drainage tunnel as royal soldiers arrive at the mill. The ferryman stays behind to delay the soldiers.

At dawn, Mira, Dain, and the witness reach the far bank. The ferryman has not returned, and they do not know whether the soldiers captured him.
